notes: ACCESS: robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow (only standard Magento admin/checkout paths blocked) - all tiers permitted. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) succeeded fully - homepage mega-menu, /storage/ landing page, all leaf category pages, sitemap.xml (2 shards, 13750 URLs) all returned 200 with server-rendered HTML including full nav and toolbar-amount product counts. No Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. TREE: built from union of (1) homepage mega-menu (nav__level1/level2, found under two separate top-level buckets - 'Furniture' and 'Homeware' - both of which contain an L1 heading literally called 'Storage' pointing to the same /storage/ URL but listing different children), (2) the /storage/ landing page's own on-page category/facet links (revealed 2 extra leaf URLs - magazine-racks and dressers - not present in the visible mega-menu), (3) sitemap.xml filtered for storage/textile-relevant path segments (confirmed no additional hidden category URLs beyond what nav+facets found), (4) the Outdoor Accessories page's own sub-nav (revealed outdoor-textiles/ and outdoor-accessories/storage/, not shown in the collapsed top mega-menu). QTY: read verbatim from each page's #toolbar-amount element ('NN Products' or '1-40 of NN Products' -> NN); every leaf's H1/canonical was checked and matched the requested slug. EXCLUDED: Furniture-bucket 'Storage' children Sideboards/Chests of Drawers/Bookcases & Shelf Units/Cabinets/Media Units/Kitchen Islands & Units/Dressers(Larders) are storage-purpose furniture explicitly placed under the site's Furniture mega-menu (breadcrumb Storage>X is just a shared URL namespace, not the real classification signal) - left for Furniture.xlsx, not duplicated here. Wardrobes (/bedroom/wardrobes/) same reasoning, plus not under /storage/ path. Drinks Trolleys excluded as serving/bar carts (storage.md #20). Knobs & Handles excluded as door/furniture hardware. Kitchen Islands & Units excluded as kitchen furniture. Pouffes/Beanbags & Floor Cushions (/seating/pouffes-beanbags-floor-cushions/) excluded from Textile - single mixed listing page dominated by furniture (pouffes/beanbags), site places it under Seating(Furniture) top nav. Christmas/New/Sale/Inspiration('stylists-edit') variants of these categories excluded as seasonal/promotional/editorial duplicate views per View-All/Collection rule. 'Order Free Swatches' (fabric swatch service page) excluded - not a product listing. Shoe Storage and Clothes Rails & Screens were pulled INTO Storage despite sitting in the Furniture-menu bucket because storage.md explicitly calls out shoe storage (#10) and clothes rails/hanging storage (#9) as Storage regardless of furniture-adjacent placement. Shelves (/storage/shelves/, wire shelf units + a few display/marble shelves) and Hooks & Hook Racks (coat hooks/rails) kept MEDIUM confidence - mixed storage/decorative product mix, but site nav places both under the Homeware>Storage bucket. Garden Storage Boxes & Cabinets (/outdoor/outdoor-accessories/storage/) kept at LOW confidence - H1 and slug are storage-labelled but the single product currently listed is an outdoor furniture cover (a textile item); category label overrides the one anomalous SKU. Sheepskin & Faux Fur soft-furnishings category kept MEDIUM confidence - mostly textile (seat pads, rugs, throws, cushions, hot-water-bottle covers) but contains 2 furniture outliers (a faux-fur pouffe and a fur-upholstered chair) within the same listing/qty.
